checks.name: origin_third_pole_and_Q_fifth_pole
checks.evidence: The coefficient of epsilon/w^3 is exactly -i, so epsilon nonzero gives pole order3 in Phi and5 in Q=Phi/w^2.

checks.name: truncation_composition_to_degree4
checks.evidence: J(h)=L(h o phi), phi(0)=0, has h4 coefficient i*epsilon*p1^4; conformal p1 nonzero preserves degree4.

checks.name: epsilon_boundary
checks.evidence: epsilon=eta^2>0; at epsilon=0 the degree4 perturbation and reversal margin disappear.

checks.name: Koebe_rotation_necessary_coefficient_obstruction
checks.evidence: If a2=2u, |u|=1, |a2-2|<8eta, then |u^3-1|<12eta and Re(u^3)>1-12eta>0. Thus Im(i*epsilon*u^3)>0, incompatible with Phi real on a radial slit.

checks.name: Toeplitz_origin_support
checks.evidence: L(h)=h''(0)/2+i*epsilon*(h''''(0)/24-h'''(0)/2). Its Toeplitz kernel is z^-3-3i*epsilon*z^-4+i*epsilon*z^-5, with nonzero order5 origin pole.
